Tamil Nadu Left Parties Warn of Withdrawing Support to TVK Government

Left parties in Tamil Nadu have warned that the state government, led by C. Joseph Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), could collapse if they withdraw their external support. CPI senior leader R. Mutharasan stated that the TVK government is dependent on the Left parties. Mutharasan also criticized the TVK government's performance.
